# anthropic_claude_tag_bundles (Data Source)

Experimental. Lists the organization's Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) Bundles (`/v1/organizations/claude_tag/bundles`). Bundles are created and edited in claude.ai. The API is read-only for them. What a Bundle grants (connectors, repositories, credentials) is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_claude_tag_bundles" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bundles` (Attributes List) Bundles in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bundles))

<a id="nestedatt--bundles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bundles`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the Bundle was created.
- `description` (String) What the Bundle is for. Null when it has none.
- `display_name` (String) Bundle name.
- `id` (String) Bundle identifier (`capp_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the Bundle.
